as_told.title: Doty doubled down on the L9 story on a podcast with Mario

plain: An Air Force veteran named Mario Woods, who says he was taken by aliens, went on another podcast with Richard Doty, one of the men he says questioned him afterward alongside a captain of the Air Force's investigations office named Jack Reed, and tried to get answers. Woods tells Michels that Doty "was so covered by the guys that did the podcast" that he could not get a straight answer, while Michels, on a later show, says Doty "kind of doubled down" there on the story of the L9 incident, an event at Ellsworth Air Force Base described in a document dated November 1977.
